desc: This B1<sup>+</sup> mapping method ([Jiru and Klose 2006](https://doi.org/10.1002/mrm.21083)) is based on two EPI readouts to acquire spin echo (SE) and stimulated echo (STE) images at multiple flip angles in one sequence, used in the calculation of deviations from the nominal flip angle. Exactly one of: .nii.gz or .nii; .ome.zarr must be present.
